rationale: The testimony maintains an indignant sworn-testimony tone, addresses the Chair directly, refuses to grovel, and reframes store-bought dishes as domestically-appropriate (Midwest potluck, Kroger/Costco, Pyrex). The speaker deflects and reframes the allegation as more American rather than confessing or apologizing.
quote:
Mr. Chairman, members of the committee—

I invoke my Fifth Amendment rights against self-incrimination regarding the provenance of the seven-layer dip.
